Each square represents 1 out of 20 Canadian deaths in 2024. The red square is MAID.
If MAID were random, 20% would come from each income quintile. It's not random.
Source: The Conversation / Ontario Coroner [7], Cardus [14]
Each red dot represents one person killed by their government in a single day.
45 circles = 45 people. Every single day. 16,499 / 366 days = 45.1 per day.
Using the government's own lowest growth rate (7.5% from 2023→2024)
Formula: N(t) = 16,499 × (1.075) t , cumulative sum from 2016 base of 76,475.
